description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy on Yogurt, Butter, Dairy Spreads etc.
categorisation: This gazette content involves the imposition and amendment of the Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It contains regulatory orders that modify existing regulations (rescinding previous orders) and establishes new levy rates for various commodities. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
